spans.s:
mfn. (-ञ्जन्-ञ्जन्ती-ञ्जत्)
1 Uniting, joining.
2 Uniting spiritually, practising devotion.
E.
युज to join, &c., शतृ aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Uniting, combining, joining with.
m. (-नः)
1 A charioteer.
2 A Brahman engaged in the religious exercise called Yoga.
E.
युज to join, &c., aff. शानच्, and नुम् inserted.
